ValidationRule.description: R-VG7: while an entry is Approved, its person, Date Worked and Hours cannot change. The coordinator moves it back to Submitted, edits it and approves it again. A validation rule, so it holds with automation off.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), OR( ISCHANGED(Contact__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Date_Worked__c), ISCHANGED(Hours__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved hours are locked. Move the entry back to Submitted to change the person, the date or the hours, then approve it again.
